preconditions.name: positive_control_hazard_in_view_decodable
preconditions.description: hazard_in_view (scene_structure_targets['hazard_present'], a STATIC single-frame property of world_obs known decodable at ~0.96 balanced accuracy per the 2026-07-18 characterisation) must be recoverable by the SAME probe methodology as the primary event-type DV. If this fails, the probe pipeline itself is broken -- substrate_not_ready_requeue, never an SD-009 verdict.
preconditions.control: hazard_in_view target, min held-out margin across all cells (both arms)

preconditions.name: encoder_actually_trained
preconditions.description: Every cell must show >=1 changed world-path tensor across P0 -- the manipulation did not take otherwise, and no SD-009 conclusion is licensed.
preconditions.control: world-path latent_stack tensors, min across all cells

interpretation.combination_rule: supports iff readiness_ok AND >=2 of 3 seeds individually satisfy (on_margin >= 0.050 AND on_margin - off_margin >= 0.030); weakens iff readiness_ok AND mean(on_margin) <= 0.050; else unknown (readiness_ok but neither clean pattern holds); substrate_not_ready_requeue iff NOT readiness_ok. Majority + paired-delta rule, not a plain criteria AND.
